name: Tacna

queries.query: Tacna Peru official cadastral map parcels municipal catastro visor
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Municipality of Tacna, the IDEP national geospatial catalogue, the GeoTakana regional viewer, and the SUNARP Base Gráfica Registral viewer. The public IDEP ArcGIS route inspected was a 1:25,000 map-sheet layer, not a parcel layer; SUNARP BGR requires DNI and issue date plus CAPTCHA.

queries.query: Tacna Perú catastro visor oficial predios parcelas mapa
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial en español confirmó a la Municipalidad Provincial de Tacna como custodio local, el catálogo IDEP/GeoTakana y el visor BGR de SUNARP. La evidencia municipal describe un catastro municipal y la subgerencia responsable, pero no publicó una API parcelaria anónima; el visor BGR exige identificación y CAPTCHA.

registryBasis: The official Municipality of Tacna documents identify the municipal cadastral function and Sub Gerencia de Planeamiento Urbano y Catastro; SUNARP provides the national registered-plot viewer. This establishes local/national custodians, not open anonymous parcel geometry.
registryCustodian: Municipalidad Provincial de Tacna, Sub Gerencia de Planeamiento Urbano y Catastro; SUNARP Base Gráfica Registral for registered plots

officialSources.observation: Official 2024 institutional evaluation states that municipal cadastral updating is an institutional action and names the Sub Gerencia de Planeamiento Urbano y Catastro; it reports cadastral-ficha indicators but no downloadable parcel layer.
Official municipal procedure names the Equipo de Catastro / municipal cadastral workflow for plan review and inspection; it is a procedure, not an anonymous parcel API.

First-party IDEP ArcGIS Feature Layer named TACNA, polygon geometry, EPSG:4326, public JSON/GeoJSON support. Fields are map-sheet/index fields (COD_IGN, SISTEMA, ZONA, NOM_HOJA, COD_HOJA), not parcel identities.
Official SUNARP service describes registered-plot map viewing by location, electronic filing number, or coordinates, but requires DNI, issue date, and CAPTCHA; no anonymous request was attempted.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; layer metadata returned geometryType esriGeometryPolygon, source/latest spatial reference 4326, maxRecordCount 1000, and map-sheet fields. Not a cadastral parcel service.
HTTP 200; returned three map-sheet records and exceededTransferLimit=true. Returned identities were sheet/index records, so no parcel geometry or parcel sample was retained.
Bounded anonymous request timed out after 8 seconds. Official service documentation separately shows DNI/issue-date/CAPTCHA requirements; no retry with credentials or CAPTCHA bypass.
HTTP 200 PDF; municipal cadastral responsibility and 2024 indicator evidence readable. No public parcel feature service exposed in the bounded inspection.
Official procedure page/PDF discovered in first-party search; it describes municipal cadastral plan review and inspection, not anonymous geometry access.
First-party regional POT viewer identified through IDEP catalogue. It concerns territorial planning/ZEE/POT layers; no parcel schema or anonymous parcel endpoint was verified.
